Service ops return true or {error,message}; model ops return {ok, errors (full_messages, en locale), path}; http ops run the real Rails app (RAILS_ENV=test, Accept: application/json) and return {status, body} or {status:500, unhandled_exception}. expected_revision_of:X means expected_revision = SHA256(X). tree_after: full snapshot (hidden files incl. .fed and lock files included; symlinks as {symlink}). '.fed' content beginning with the template generated by Config is shown as '<FED_TEMPLATE>' + rest (template text in fixture key fed_template); <TMP> = parent of <ROOT>; random temp-file hex in error messages -> <HEX>. in input trees '<FED_TEMPLATE>' prefix is expanded the same way. Time is frozen with travel_to(2026-01-30T12:34:56.789012Z) (Hugo dates, recent opened_at); TZ=UTC. stat_mode results for newly created files depend on process umask (generated with umask 0022). list_tree mtimes of files written during ops are masked to <TIME>.
